title: UniTask and coroutine lifecycle
version_scope: Inspect the installed UniTask revision and Unity version before copying APIs.
source_facts: UniTask integrates async work with Unity PlayerLoop and supports cancellation tokens.
Unity coroutines express work across frames and are not equivalent to background threads.
local_policy: Do not mass-convert coroutines merely because UniTask is installed.
Separate scene lifetime, pooled object lifetime, and application lifetime.
Treat cancellation separately from faults and unobserved fire-and-forget failures.

title: Google Mobile Ads and UMP
version_scope: Resolve Unity plugin and Android/iOS native SDK versions independently.
source_facts: Mobile Ads initialization precedes normal ad loading flows.
UMP exposes consent information and whether ads may be requested.
Development should use sample ad units or registered test devices.
local_policy: Reward and close are distinct events; do not grant rewards from close alone.
Never enable live paid advertising as part of a harness smoke test.
Treat consent handling as platform-sensitive and require review.

title: Unity IAP v5 purchase lifecycle
version_scope: com.unity.purchasing major 5; exact installed API must be inspected.
source_facts: IAP v5 separates store connection, product retrieval, and purchase retrieval.
Pending purchase handling and confirmation are explicit parts of the v5 lifecycle.
local_policy: Do not mechanically port deprecated Product.transactionID usage from IAP v4.
Preserve identifiers as strings and inspect installed Order/cart/product APIs.
Use idempotent fulfillment and server-authoritative verification for live games.

title: Firebase Auth, Google/Apple sign-in, and account linking
version_scope: Inspect Firebase Unity SDK plus the actual platform sign-in provider implementation.
source_facts: Firebase account linking preserves one Firebase user identity when provider credentials are linked to the signed-in user.
Apple authentication uses nonce-sensitive credential flows on Apple platforms.
Provider credentials already linked to another account require explicit conflict handling.
local_policy: Do not confuse provider tokens with Firebase ID tokens.
Do not copy UIDs client-side to merge accounts.
Never log tokens, nonces, credentials, or private project configuration.

title: Android and iOS native dependency diagnostics
version_scope: Observe Unity, Gradle/AGP/JDK, CocoaPods/Xcode, ABI, target SDK, and installed plugin versions.
source_facts: Unity Android and iOS builds cross native toolchain boundaries where external dependencies participate.
Native crash evidence must be distinguished from managed C# exceptions.
local_policy: Collect the real dependency graph and device ABI before changing versions blindly.
Do not attribute SIGSEGV to Unity C# code without symbolized/native evidence.
Escalate native loader, IL2CPP, Gradle, Xcode, signing, and entitlement changes to architect review.
